answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is tied to capital lockup rather than ephemeral identity. An attacker attempting to build a plume of fake agents faces the economic horizon of prohibitive entry costs, as scaling requires acquiring significant collateral. This structure functions like a glacier, where the sheer mass of staked assets provides security by ensuring that any attempt to flood the network mandates an unsustainable financial sacrifice.
